machine_check.reproducible_command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
p=json.load(open('.research/tool-discovery-inventory-census.json')); rows=p['rows']; ids=[r['inventory_id'] for r in rows]
assert len(rows)==20 and len(set(ids))==20
assert set(ids)=={f'EXT-F-{n}' for n in range(4001,4021)}
assert all(r['status'] in {'present','renamed','absent','unknown'} for r in rows)
assert all(r['runtime_availability']=='unknown' for r in rows)
assert all(r['control_case_mapping']['control_id'] in r['control_case_mapping']['case_control_ids'] for r in rows)
print(p['summary'])
PY
